scientific_integrity: The central claim concerns Prym ordinarity and the precise superspecial quotient locus, rather than authorship of the ambient family, general Cartier formula, or independent novelty certification.
scientific_limitations: Only the smooth odd-polynomial cyclic-trigonal pencil in characteristic seven; not all genus-four curves or other primes; a 2025 related general a-number article was available at abstract level only and may overlap the matrix subcalculation; independent scientific validation not performed.
title: Ordinary Pryms and an isolated superspecial quotient in a characteristic-seven cyclic-trigonal pencil
